name: Alluvial Soil
management_tips: Apply gypsum (500 kg/ha) if sodic; ensure canal drainage during Samba; add organic matter to improve aeration; ideal for transplanted rice

name: Black Cotton Soil (Vertisol)
management_tips: Deep summer ploughing to break hard crust; add gypsum 2 t/ha for sodicity; broad bed furrow sowing to prevent waterlogging; avoid heavy machinery during wet season; lime if pH >8.5

name: Red Laterite Soil
management_tips: Apply lime 1-2 t/ha to correct acidity; add FYM 10 t/ha to improve water retention; mulching essential to reduce evaporation; apply zinc sulphate (25 kg/ha) regularly; check for iron toxicity under waterlogged conditions

name: Sandy Coastal Soil
management_tips: Heavy organic matter addition essential; drip irrigation mandatory due to low water retention; apply slow-release fertilizers; green manure incorporation; windbreak plantations to prevent erosion; saline-tolerant varieties

name: Forest Laterite Soil
management_tips: Apply lime 2 t/ha every 3 years; phosphate fertilizer important; terracing for steep slopes; organic matter from leaf mold; drip irrigation on slopes

name: Deep Black Alluvial (Delta Soil)
management_tips: Provide field channels for drainage; apply gypsum 500 kg/ha; avoid deep tillage when wet; organic matter addition to improve micronutrient availability; raised bed planting for non-rice crops

name: Sandy Loam
management_tips: FYM 10 t/ha improves water retention; split fertilizer application to reduce leaching; drip irrigation efficient; lime if pH <6.0; check zinc deficiency

name: Red Sandy Loam
management_tips: Zinc sulphate application (25 kg/ha) at basal; phosphate fertilizer critical; FYM or vermicompost to improve water holding; avoid over-irrigation; summer ploughing

name: Saline-Alkaline Soil
management_tips: Apply gypsum @ 4-5 t/ha; good drainage essential; green manure incorporation (Sesbania/Dhaincha); leaching by excess irrigation before crop; apply rice husk ash; avoid ammonium sulphate

name: Waterlogged / Swampy Soil
districts: Low-lying areas in delta districts; some coastal pockets
management_tips: Sub-surface drainage installation; raised bed cultivation; Sesbania for waterlogged areas; reclamation with field channels
